note: Boone County Conservation park west of Madrid, on a USACE lease from the Saylorville Lake project: a small paved loop in oak-hickory woods on the bluff above the Des Moines River, which is a steep hike down into the valley with no access or view from the sites. Half a mile from the High Trestle Trail. Hiking trails, prairie, playground, sand volleyball. No site lengths are published and campers call the sites 'a little close'; check fit before booking. --Claude
summary: Fees $18 and 30-amp electric confirmed; '30/110-amp' was just 30 amp. Added 16 RV sites (14 + 2 electric ground), flush toilets, platform/url; showers, potable water, season Apr 15-Oct 15, 14-night max and FCFS tent sites confirmed. Fit unclear (no lengths; pads look like ordinary pull-in spurs on leaf-off imagery) - kept with a caveat in the note. Not waterfront kept. Note cleaned.
flags: FIT (unclear, keep with caveat): no site lengths on any county or MyCountyParks page; the contract lists 'Motor home' among allowed camping units.
